description: This file defines a utility support structure for managing mouse tracking areas within a macOS application. It contains a single enum with a static method to reset the mouse tracking area on a given NSView.

methods.name: resetMouseTracking
methods.description: Resets the mouse tracking area for a given NSView by removing the existing tracking area (if any), creating a new NSTrackingArea with specified options, and adding it to the view. It updates the provided tracking reference accordingly.
